name: clawd-logs
description: Watches your project's error logs (WordPress debug.log, nginx, any log file): new errors show above the prompt, grouped, with a Fix button, and Claude hears about the ones its own work caused

minLevel.title: Show from level
minLevel.description: The least severe errors that show: fatal, error, warning (the default; hides notices and deprecations) or notice (everything).

tellClaude.title: Tell Claude
tellClaude.description: When an error appears while Claude is working, add it to what Claude reads after its next tool call, so it notices what its change broke.

refreshSeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the logs are checked while Claude is idle. They are also checked after each of Claude's tool calls.
